## Enable

```bash
nika run workflow.nika.yaml --events ndjson
```

## Every event has

```json
{
  "ts": "T+<offset>",
  "run_id": "r_01J...",
  "kind": "<event_kind>",
  "...": "kind-specific fields"
}
```
